flows.name: Canvas interaction and persistence
steps: Select a markup tool and color
flows.expectedOutcome: Canvas behavior persists across reload and remains usable after edit, delete, and undo.

flows.name: Viewport and linked-record interaction
flows.expectedOutcome: Viewport controls retain their behavior and semantic pin/link intents reach the canonical route.

checks: Side panels preserve a visible canvas
Loading and failed-save states are visible

claims.description: Annotation creation, reload, edit/delete, and undo are captured
Pan, wheel zoom, toolbar zoom, rotation, tool/color, and filter behavior are captured
Pin selection and link placement are captured at the canonical route
A failed annotation operation names the failure and preserves a recovery path
Desktop, tablet, and mobile visual review is complete
A durable interaction-seam regression test exists
